mostWorthwhile.text: Assembling the hair cells with the cochlear membranes was most worthwhile: the planned inset connects relative motion to bending hair bundles, and the next result links that motion to nerve signals.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the hearing pathways was comparatively routine: the result shows their connection to a schematic brain but says little about what the relays do.

surprise.text: The useful distinction was that relative motion bends the hair bundles, rather than the description simply saying sound reaches the cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the fittings followed the visible route from canal to brain. The named brainstem relays were not explained, however, so their role in that route remained unclear.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter if it developed the same structure-to-function explanations; the cochlear mechanism was interesting, although the mostly predictable fittings offered few meaningful choices.
